source_text.body:
Get a subscription refund through a support bot
The poster requested a Claude refund via the support chat bot and says it was approved right away.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster says they opened Claude, clicked Help, and used the support bot rather than emailing support. They selected performance issue as the reason, followed the bot’s prompts, and the refund was approved immediately by email; in comments they added they still had 12 days left on the subscription.
How it went
The reported result was an immediate approval, with the email saying the money could take up to 5 working days to reach their bank. Comments suggest this was not guaranteed for everyone, since another user said a similar request was denied after 12 days of Max use.
Worth knowing
The main catch from the thread is timing: the poster said they had 12 days left on the subscription when they asked.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me request a refund for my [service name] subscription. Open the help or support chat at [support page URL], explain that I was charged [amount] on [date] and want a refund because [reason], and follow the bot's steps. Before you confirm or submit anything final, pause and show me what you're about to send. Finish by giving me the refund status and any confirmation or case number.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Anthropic/comments/1nez0aa/i_asked_for_a_refund_on_claude_and_got_it
